title: WorkflowDraft
description: What Devin returns to the platform. The designer loads workflowYaml onto the canvas; a person reviews and saves it.

status.description: working while drafting, ready when validation passes, needs_input when only the user can unblock it.

summary.description: Two or three plain sentences on what the workflow does.

workflowYaml.description: The whole Workflow file (apiVersion iaf.platform/v1, kind Workflow). Empty string until the first valid draft.

changes.description: What changed since the previous structured output, one line each, so the canvas can show a diff.

assumptions.description: Defaults Devin chose where the description was silent.

questions.description: Only when status is needs_input. Each answerable in a word, with options.

missing.description: Building blocks the flow needs that do not exist yet in the registry.

path.description: Step ids in the order the dry run executed them.
